description: Monorepo-architect patterns for ModMe federated dual-stack workflow gates

federated-dual-stack.title: Federated dual-stack
federated-dual-stack.principle: Independent monorepos; HTTP/WebSocket integration only; no workspace:* cross-imports

path-filtered-ci.title: Path-filtered CI
path-filtered-ci.principle: Single stack-paths manifest drives CI, pre-push hooks, and agent verify

contract-first-integration.title: Contract-first integration
contract-first-integration.principle: Golden Zod schemas and WS contracts before UI migration cutover

bounded-parallel-agents.title: Bounded parallel agents
bounded-parallel-agents.principle: Serial plan, parallel exploration waves, serial commit

ecl-structured-change.title: ECL structured change
ecl-structured-change.principle: Harness lint gates structural and cross-stack changes

uw-flow-behavior-sync.title: UW .flow behavior sync
uw-flow-behavior-sync.principle: Tests drive behavior registry; scanners sync DONE/IN_PROGRESS/PLANNED from test results

uw-flow-taxonomy.title: UW .flow taxonomy
uw-flow-taxonomy.principle: Feature taxonomy YAML + README define behavior domains for agent-dev workflows

uw-agent-inbox-pipeline-tools.title: UW agent inbox pipeline tools
uw-agent-inbox-pipeline-tools.principle: Base UW agent tools/workflows are pattern references; root intake scripts are the runtime

uw-generate-schemas-py.title: UW generate_schemas.py
uw-generate-schemas-py.principle: Scan TS tool interfaces and SKILL.md files to emit JSON schemas and agent prompts

uw-worktree-scripts.title: UW worktree scripts
uw-worktree-scripts.principle: UW-local worktree and feature scaffold scripts stay in the archive tree

uw-validation-patterns-doc.title: UW validation patterns docs
uw-validation-patterns-doc.principle: Validation playbook and feature taxonomy docs remain UW knowledge, not forge runtime
